title: How to actually become an AI architect in 2026
oneliner: Learn from the right sources, share your understanding publicly, then implement it on a real project - consumption alone is not the path.
says: His career formula: identify the right articles, webinars, videos, and podcasts; collect the right books (linked in his description) and read them; then contribute your understanding back as blogs, vlogs, and videos; and seek a project in your organization where you can implement what you learned.
explained: The loop is learn - share - implement, and the middle step is the one most people skip. Sharing forces understanding: you cannot write a clear blog post about something you half-know, and the attempt exposes the gaps. It also builds the public evidence of skill that later reels tie directly to interview calls.

The last step is the filter that makes the rest count. Knowledge you never implement decays into trivia. His advice to seek the project inside your current organization is deliberate - you rarely need to change jobs to start practicing architecture; you need to attach yourself to the work. That is also how the enterprise-architect opportunity from reel #6 actually opens up.
takeaway: Close the loop (complete the full cycle): learn it, teach it publicly, build it at work. Any missing step stalls the other two.
